assessment: Both abstracts use a canola oil comparator in the same 30-person ketone-ester trial in older adults. The identified full exploratory report assesses PSQI, and its daytime dysfunction proxy is inconclusive. The trial has no confirmed refined grade, Parkinson cohort or oil-free control.

assessment: The clinical vignette describes potatoes among multiple foods in a patient's restricted diet amid dysgeusia and weight loss after SARS-CoV-2.
